steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Gummy, it's just us. So, be honest with me, what do you think?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You're… you're really serious about this?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Of course, it's very important to me.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Um... Alright.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You want me to be totally honest?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I assure you, I can take it.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Well... Actually, it's not bad.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Mhm. All in all, Rosa, you stick close to the recipe when you cook, so your dishes will taste fine.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Wonderful!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But at the same time, you might be sticking to the recipe a little too close.

spans.text: But at the same time, you might be sticking to the recipe a little

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Oh, what's wrong with that?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Cooks usually don't follow the recipe exactly. You're doing it all so carefully, it's not gonna make the food bad, but... it won't be really good either.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I see... no wonder I always feel like my cooking could never be as good as yours.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hehe, I've got so much experience, I've been tempered a thousand times over.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Rosa, that you can manage this much is already really good, you've definitely surpassed Zima.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: This is one arena I wouldn't be too happy about besting her.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Gummy, Rosa, is the food ready? The patients are almost done with their treatment.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, Uncle Matterhorn! It's ready. Rosa and I will bring it out now.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Great, thanks.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Let's hop to it.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Right, I do hope this meal will lift their spirits.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hello, everyone!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Hi, Gummy, what comfort food have you made the patients today?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's not my cooking this time, it's Rosa's!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Actually, I just needed an excuse to have Gummy teach me her culinary arts.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Let me tell you, Medic, Rosa worked really hard to make all these dishes extra tasty.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: And Master Chef Gummy is proud to have such a good student.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Sounds like Rhodes Island will soon have another chef.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: There's still so much I want to learn. Let's bring the patients their food for now.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: This way.

steps.name: Lively Female Patient
steps.text: Judging by your accent, you're not Victorian, are you?

steps.name: Chatty Female Patient
steps.text: *sigh* Don't bring it up. My husband was sick, so we went from Ursus to Victoria to get him treated.

steps.name: Chatty Female Patient
steps.text: He got better, but I ended up with this damnable Oripathy.

steps.name: Lively Female Patient
steps.text: So, your husband…

steps.name: Chatty Female Patient
steps.text: He didn't abandon me. He asked all around to find this place, he's the one who brought me here.

steps.name: Lively Female Patient
steps.text: Then you're one of the lucky ones.

steps.name: Chatty Female Patient
steps.text: Lucky?! You don't know, before he got sick, I worked as a maidservant to an important household. That's what I'd call lucky.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: The patients are here, I'll help you serve the food.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Very good.

steps.name: Chatty Female Patient
steps.text: Huh...

steps.name: Chatty Female Patient
steps.text: Lady Natalya, is that Lady Natalya?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You… could you be Sofia?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Yes, Sofia, I was your maid! Sofia!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You're… That's right, I remember you left before the incident in Chernobog.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Yes, yes, I had to get my deadbeat Alexey treated. That meant leaving the service of your house, and use the money I'd saved to take him to Victoria.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: I heard what happened in Chernobog and I was so worried about you, I'm glad to see you're all right.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: But what are you doing here?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I…

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Oh, the House of Rostov owns this company! You must be in charge here, yes?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Lady Natalya, please show mercy to your sad, pitiful old maid.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Alexey had me running ragged. I never imagined I would catch Oripathy.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Please grant me your mercy, ask the people here to give me some more medicine. I want to live.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No, I'm not in charge here, Sofia.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: But, then, what are you doing here?
Everyone in the room is watching them, Rosa realizes, and decides it's not the place to talk.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Rosa, I'll take it from here.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Yes... Thank you, Gummy.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Come with me, Sofia.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Step inside.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: My lady, is this...?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: This is my dorm room.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Dorm room? How can you live in a place like this?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Even our servants quarters were nicer than this!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I've grown used to it.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: No, no, no, you're noble, how could you be used to this barn?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: If His Serenity and the Countess knew, I can't imagine how devastated they would be!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: The House of Rostov has fallen, Sofia.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: It's... what?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: The Reunion Movement destroyed Chernobog, including her wealth and the dignity of her people.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: You don't mean the Count and Countess are...?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: …No.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: In the aftermath, I sought news of my mother and father.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: They are not dead. They were luckier than me, and managed to escape Chernobog.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: In the contrary, they thought me dead, and made for another city. As it stands, they have put down roots in some city or other.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: I-In that case, why would you stay on this ship?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: This is no place for you!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: You should be looking for His Serenity and the Countess!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: So long as they live, the House of Rostov can return to its former glory!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: If I intended to do that, I would have done it when I made it out.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But I don't intend to do that, the Natalya you knew is dead.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Here and now, I am just Rosa, the Rhodes Island operator.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Oh dear, I see what this is. You had an argument with your parents and ran away from home, didn't you?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Take it.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Ah, what's this...? Istina and I were discussing this one at the book club, The Brothers Dostoyev?

spans.text: Ah, what's this...? Istina and I were discussing this one at the book club,

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: What are you doing with it, Zima?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anna dug it up for you and asked me to hand it over. She's out on a mission.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Girl, who gave you permission to speak to Lady Natalya in such a manner?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: There's no need for that, Sofia.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: No, my lady, trust me. Give an inch to these people who don't know their place and they'll gladly take mile after mile.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Girl, when presenting an item to your betters, you must offer it respectfully with both hands. What are you doing just dropping it on her?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Who the hell asked you?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: So vulgar! Looking at your clothes, you're a student of Peterheim Middle School?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Got a problem with that?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Are you are my lady's new maid? How can you possibly not know proper etiquette?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Wha? Say that again.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Heavens, my lady, I do recall you once said Peterheim Middle School dragged the character of Chernobog's students into the mud.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: And now you're reduced to taking one of their girls into your service.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Even if you refuse to return to Ursus, we must find a place more befitting of your status!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph, she hasn't been a princess for a long time now.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Sigh, vulgar girl, you think just because you live in the same place as my lady, that makes you her equal?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Look at the book you just handed her, and the others on this shelf: opera, sheet music—

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Even in such an environment, my lady has kept her refined taste.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Do you honestly believe that you and she are equals?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ugh, so she's a noble, is that supposed to be badass or something?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: I have served many nobles, I know what true nobility is.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: And I say Lady Natalya is the very picture of high nobility, the embodiment of it!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: (Whispers) Let it go.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Don't forget, you've got shit to do today.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I'm well aware.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: What's that? My lady, please do let me help you with any work you may have.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Nothing too difficult. A teacher in a nearby village was injured, leaving the children without an instructor. I will go to substitute.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: What? My lady, how could you deign to do such a thing?!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Let me speak to the person in charge at once.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: How could they possibly expect you to do anything like that?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No, Sofia, I volunteered for it.

steps.name: Lively Student
steps.text: Hi, Miss Rosa!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Barney, is your father feeling better?

steps.name: Lively Student
steps.text: Yeah! He told me to thank the Rhodes Island doctors!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You just do well in school, that will be all the gratitude we need.

steps.name: Lively Student
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Timid Student
steps.text: Hi, M-Miss Rosa.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Ah, Taytay, you finally decided to come to school!

steps.name: Timid Student
steps.text: Yes, Mum w-wanted me t-to give this to you to say th-ank y-you.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Herbs?

steps.name: Timid Student
steps.text: Yes, I-I p-picked them yesterday.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Thank you—

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Oh, my lady, let me take them for you.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: This grass is filthy, you'll dirty your hands.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Little one, Lady Natalya is kind-hearted. But next time, you must bring a better gift to thank her.

steps.name: Timid Student
steps.text: S-Sorry.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: There's no need to say sorry, Taytay.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Sofia, please wait for me outside.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: But, it's far too dirty in here. How could I let you teach in a place like this?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I'm ordering you to leave.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: …Yes, ma'am.
Rosa looks around at the simple and crude warehouse-turned-classroom. A dozen or so pairs of eyes watch her with either curiosity or surprise.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Sorry, children, that was rather embarrassing.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Let's begin today's lesson.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Now, if you would please turn to page sixty-seven in your textbooks—

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: *sigh*, what happened to you, my lady?

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: Hey, what's wrong with you? What're you doing hanging around here?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: I am Lady Natalya's maid.

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: Natalya? Oh, you mean Miss Rosa, she told me her name before.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Yes, her.

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: This is the first I've heard of her having a maid.

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: That can't be right. If Miss Rosa was a noblewoman with servants, why's she out working for money?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: What do you mean money?!

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: Yes, when our local teacher got hurt on a hunt and had to be treated at Rhodes Island, Miss Rosa heard we needed a substitute and took it upon herself to come.

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: At first, we also thought she was a noblewoman keeping herself entertained. But after a couple days of teaching, we could tell she was the real deal, a fine teacher.

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: So, we wanted to pay her.

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: She said she wanted to earn enough to buy a thing. Turned out to be something called a piano?

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: A few days ago, she said she'd saved up enough for the piano, but she still comes in to teach.

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: If you're her maid and she really is a noblewoman, then why is she here teaching?

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: Are you sure you don't have the wrong person?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Impossible!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Lady Natalya is a noblewoman through and through!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: The blood of the House of Rostov runs in her veins, she's high born!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: You simple peasants couldn't fathom the life my lady used to live!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: That's enough, Sofia.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I could hear you talking from inside.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: My lady, how could you? How could you debase yourself like this?!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: You're the pride of the House of Rostov! You're defiling your own nobility!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Sofia!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I've tried to be patient with you, but this time you've gone too far.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Are you desperately trying to prove my nobility because I really am noble, or because you want to prove that you're superior?!

spans.text: Are you desperately trying to prove my nobility because I really am noble, or because you want to prove that

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Am I wrong?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: I had a good life in the House of Rostov!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Every day, I only needed think of how best to serve the Count, the Countess, and you. The days were busy, but oh so fulfilling. In the evenings, I still had time to go to the theater.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Those were wonderful days!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Do you know how much I've suffered since I left the household?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: I've had to work my fingers to the bone just to keep me and Alexey alive. And in the end, what do I have to show for it?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Just this damned Oripathy!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: I can't imagine why you wouldn't want to go back to that life!

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: All you have to do is go back to Ursus and you'll be a noblewoman again. All you have to do is let me go with you, and it can all go back to the way it was!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Sofia... I'm sorry.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But I didn't deserve that life.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: And you're the same, what could you have possibly done to deserve all the suffering you've endured?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I don't blame you for wanting to go back, because I took everything for granted myself.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But—it's not right.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: This is something that needs to change.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: How do you say all of that so easily?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: If I don't deserve any of this, If I don't think I deserve any of this, then what am I supposed to do?

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: I don't know, my lady, I don't know. I'm going to die.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I'm sorry you had to see all of that.

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: I understand, she seems like a sad woman.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Could I please have my pay for today?

steps.name: Village Head
steps.text: Of course, of course, I have it here.
Rosa takes the bag from the village head and pours the coins into her own purse.
The purse bulges, it looks like she's gathered a small fortune.
Rosa hesitates for a moment, then walks up to Sofia and places the purse in her hand.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Sofia, take this, and go back.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: What's this...?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: A portion of my savings, enough to pay for your course of treatment.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: This is all I can do for you, as your former master.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: For this day onward, you will not refer to me as 'my lady'. If I should return to Ursus one day, it will not be as a child of the House of Rostov.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I have a codename at Rhodes Island, I am—

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Rosa.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You must also address me by this name, I'm just an operator here.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: M-My lady…

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: I still don't understand.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: Why do you choose to live like this?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: One day... you will understand.

steps.name: Sofia the Former Maid
steps.text: No, I will find out where the Count and Countess are. I'll send Alexey to tell them you're still alive.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You can do what you think is best.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: However, when the time comes, I will be the one to make the choice.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Are you sure about this? You could use that money.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I told them what happened. Anna was worried about you, so she dragged me along with her.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: The money is gone, but I can earn more.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Of course, there are some things that must be done.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph, look at you acting all mature.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: It can't be helped. It's as I said, this is all I can do.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Hello, what is it?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, Your Worship, you got a delivery. Real big sucker too.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Do you mean—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yep, your piano's here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Better hurry back.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Zima, Istina, we have to go back, now!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What's the rush? It's not going anywhere!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But I can't wait!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ugh, the girl's barely got anything fancy in her at all anymore.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And so she's become more and more likable.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Why are you taking her side too?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm only stating facts.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I think it's working on you too, Sonya.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I don't like her.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Aw, hell, that piano cost a fortune. If she's gotta move it by herself, she could drop the damned thing and then it'll cost even more money to fix.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Better head back and help her.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Haha, sure.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Let's put it here.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Did you make space for the piano before?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Yes, after all, this is the most money I've spent since I came to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I've thought about it every day.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I just don't get why the maid was so upset when she found out you bought a piano with money you made yourself.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Because if she recognized that I wasn't nobility, then she would lose someone she thought she could rely on.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: So she can rely on herself.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: That isn't easy to accept. You know how long it took me to figure it out.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I don't blame her. It's Ursus… No, it's the aristocracy, a powerful system that made her like this.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I hope that in the future, everyone can live by your words, Zima.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: So they can rely on themselves.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If you did it, anyone can, right?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And if they can't, I'll go help them figure it out.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Yes... help them figure it out.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Thinking on that... I believe I've found a reason to return to Ursus.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I don't get you. Always talking about the obvious stuff.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: And that's why I envy you, you always know what's obvious.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: …but I can't pretend I didn't hear what you said before.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: So when I told you I wanted to save up for the piano, you actually thought I couldn't do it?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: …I never said that.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Hmph, you thought I was pamper and spoiled, that I couldn't press on.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I think it works. Now if Your Worship started bouncing around like me after becoming an operator, that would be weird.

spans.text: I think it works. Now if Your Worship started bouncing around like me after becoming an operator,

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Your Worship is still a fancy girl.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Mhm, in any case, you did exchange your own labor for this piano.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We all hoped you could do it.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Yep yep, isn't that right, Zima?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What are you looking at me for?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: A valued member of our team just fulfilled her wish! You're our leader, so of course you've gotta congratulate her!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Uh, congrats.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Now then, fellow members of the Ursus Student Self-government Group, you will be my first audience.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hooray, I've always wanted to hear Rosa play!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Yes, I'm also looking forward to it.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Uh oh, when you say that, I feel a little shy.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: And it's been so long since I last played piano. You're not allowed to laugh at me if I'm not good.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: We won't!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I wouldn't be able to tell anyway.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If you're gonna play, then play already.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Hmph, I didn't ask you two.
Rosa approaches the piano and presses the keys. For a split second, she feels as if she's turned back into Natalya.

spans.text: Rosa approaches the piano and presses the keys. For a split second, she feels as if she's turned back into

steps.text: She sits in the center of an extravagant room, filled with distinguished guests attentively watching her performance. She need not worry about anything, she need only enjoy that simpler, more elegant time.
Although, this piano's tone isn't quite as good as the exquisite one she once owned—No, the one she never truly owned.
The piano's roughness drags her back to reality.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Now then, my dear friends, the piece I will be performing for you is—'Für Lorenz'.
The audience is only four girls, and the room is quite simple, and she has many worries.
The sound of the piano rings out, and it's somewhat rough.
But it's for the best.
She chose this, and she loves it.
